title: [clinic · EX-04] Manufacture an eval set for a new domain
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-04` — Manufacture an eval set for a new domain](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-04-manufacture-an-eval-set-for-a-new-domain.md) · difficulty 🟡

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Writing the questions first and looking for evidence afterwards. That reintroduces exactly the annotation-error floor the fact-graph construction exists to remove.

**2.** Generating only questions the retriever can already answer. An eval set with no failures cannot measure an improvement.

**3.** No null questions. Without them you cannot measure abstention at all, and the set silently rewards a system that never refuses.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-04]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
